verdict.rationale: React's own docs describe async Server Components fetching data (react-docs-7), streaming HTML while fetching (react-docs-6), and the 'use client' directive for marking interactive client components (react-docs-10), which together implement the exact server-fetch-then-pass-to-client pattern described in the story. missing for 10: a first-party end-to-end code example combining server data fetching with client component props, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond React's own documentation.
